description: Where each confidence level starts, as the share of messages that should not match that still reach it. Each starts at the line at the earliest.

high.description: The score High confidence starts at: past `medium`, and past all but `highRate` of the examples that should not match. Unset, nothing reaches High: there were no such examples or no traffic sample.
high.title: high

highRate.description: The share of messages like the examples that should not match expected to score `high` or more: 1 in 20, or 1 in one more than their number when they are too few to show that.
highRate.title: highRate

medium.description: The score Medium confidence starts at: past all but `mediumRate` of the traffic sample. Unset, nothing reaches Medium: there was no traffic sample.
medium.title: medium

mediumRate.description: The share of ordinary messages like the traffic sample expected to score `medium` or more: 1 in 1000, or 1 in one more than its size when it is too small to show that.
mediumRate.title: mediumRate

title: CorpusEvaluationConfidence
